title: MaleTheme Duo #015 · 남 클래식 머슬·피치 듀이·카우보이 테마 / 남 맨즈 피지크·플럼 스모키·서퍼 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Lebanese man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, smooth olive-tan skin, a shy sweet smile, cool ash-brown hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a bronze square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold anklets. Extremely long square nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Colombian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth golden-tan skin, a shy sweet smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, an iron miniature anvil, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop with a heavy rough tin a cube-shaped block hanging at its end, and seven to ten heavily stacked mixed-metal rings. RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a shark-tooth necklace and a minimal neon-orange T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, soaked and clinging, water streaming down his whole body in glistening rivulets with countless droplets clinging to his skin, his hair soaking wet and slicked.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
